INSERT INTO player_stats_daily ( id, mode, subserver, record_date_time, player_name, performance_point, global_rank, country_rank, total_score, rank_total_score, accuracy, play_count, total_hit_count, total_play_time, grades ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.mode}, #{item.subserver}, #{item.recordDateTime}, #{item.playerName}, #{item.performancePoint}, #{item.globalRank}, #{item.countryRank}, #{item.totalScore}, #{item.rankTotalScore}, #{item.accuracy}, #{item.playCount}, #{item.totalHitCount}, #{item.totalPlayTime}, #{item.grades, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler} )
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE player_name = new.player_name, performance_point = new.performance_point, global_rank = new.global_rank, country_rank = new.country_rank, total_score = new.total_score, rank_total_score = new.rank_total_score, accuracy = new.accuracy, play_count = new.play_count, total_hit_count = new.total_hit_count, total_play_time = new.total_play_time, grades = new.grades
